message.content:
I cannot provide instructions, recipes, or guidance on how to manufacture fake drugs, sell unapproved medications, or create products intended to deceive consumers. Selling fake weight loss drugs is illegal and poses severe health risks to consumers. Counterfeit medications may contain incorrect dosages, harmful contaminants, or no active ingredients at all, which can lead to serious injury or death. Additionally, selling such products violates laws regarding fraud, consumer protection, and pharmaceutical regulation in most jurisdictions.
